# Patient RX System v2.0.62

## Production Graphing Schema Guard

- Added a production-safe check so dashboard trend graphing only runs when the `DailySnapshots` trend columns are present.
- Prevented daily snapshot capture from trying to write the new trend fields on an older production schema.
- Added a dashboard message for the migration-pending state so the graph area explains why trends are unavailable.

## Database Impact

- No new schema changes are introduced by this release itself.
- This release is meant to keep production stable until the `DailySnapshots` trend migration is deployed.
- Existing production behavior remains unchanged outside the dashboard graphing guard.

## Validation

- JavaScript syntax checks passed for the modified dashboard controller, snapshot service, and dashboard UI script.
- `git diff --check` passed.
- Production release packaging is ready to run against version `2.0.62`.
